description: Windows Dynamic Island with media controls, synced lyrics, per-app audio, clipboard, system statistics, privacy indicators, and Spotlight search.
notes: The upstream V-Notch-Setup.nsi script stages the application payload under $PLUGINSDIR\payload and names the main executable V-Notch.exe. This manifest extracts that payload rather than running the setup wizard; confirm the path with the manual extraction test before treating the manifest as fully verified.

The current stable build targets net8.0-windows and is framework-dependent. .NET 8 Desktop Runtime is required; install it separately (Scoop package suggestion: versions/windowsdesktop-runtime-8.0). The NSIS bootstrapper's runtime-install routine is not executed by Scoop.
The application's own update mechanism is left unchanged.
